# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Fixed the biofilter regression in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs` by restoring TAN-only exposure and clearance tracking in the habitat-geometry probe, renaming the threshold/failure labels back to TAN semantics, and updating the probe summary text to report TAN metrics consistently. This brings the probe back in line with its documented "clears TAN faster" behavior and allows the aggregate habitat-geometry summary test to pass again.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the failing habitat-geometry probe output and isolated the biofilter regression to the recent shift from TAN metrics to combined reduced-nitrogen tracking.
2. [Completed] Patched `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs` so the biofilter probe again measures TAN exposure/clearance, with matching constant names, failure labels, and summary strings.
3. [Completed] Reformatted the probe file and reran the habitat-geometry probe suite plus diff hygiene checks to confirm the fix.

## Validation Evidence

- `rustfmt crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes -- --nocapture` passed with 6/6 tests, including `probe_biofilter_scaling_bigger_media_faster_cycling` and `all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary`.
- The passing biofilter probe now reports TAN exposure `1509.48 -> 1214.67` and TAN clearance `None -> Some(424)h`, matching the restored TAN-based assertions.
- `git diff --check -- crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs` returned clean.

## Outstanding Risks

- Validation was targeted to `e2e_habitat_geometry_probes`; I did not rerun the full `tank_harness`, `tank_core`, or workspace test suites after this harness-only fix.
- The working tree still contains unrelated local changes outside this file (`.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` and untracked `.ralph-burning/`), which I left untouched.
